text:
claudia: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's KV eviction cascade. I sketched owners, short timelines, and the testing additions we need (regression bank, canary replay, synthetic fuzz). Need quick ack and any objections.
tomas: thanks. please list owners and deliverables.
claudia: owners: regression prompt bank -> @nina; canary replay + weekly cron -> @lee; synthetic fuzz harness + tokenization checks -> @tomas. ETA: prompt bank 6 business days, canary replay 3 days, fuzz harness 7 days.
nina: I can do the prompt bank. plan to pull 18 edge cases from traces and 12 synthesized variations. where are the traces?
claudia: traces: s3://incident-archives/kv-evict/2026-03-22/. use tools/sample_trace.py to export lines. snippet: ```bash python tools/sample_trace.py s3://incident-archives/kv-evict/2026-03-22 --out tests/promptsets/kv-evict-bank.jsonl```
lee: taking the canary replay. will create a k8s CronJob scheduled 02:45 UTC to replay a representative minute of traffic every night against staging-router with concurrency=30, max_tokens=200. will open helm PR.
tomas: will build a lightweight fuzz harness that permutes token boundaries and bracketed inputs; will also add a tokenizer edge-case suite. will gate on median latency and similarity score.
claudia: proposed CI gating: add a GitHub Action in evals/regressions/kv-evict that runs the prompt bank and fuzz harness on PRs touching router/serving code. Fail if top-1 similarity drops > 3% or median token latency increases > 15%.
nina: question: format for prompt bank? jsonl with fields {"prompt","expected_prefix","notes"}?
claudia: yes. simple jsonl with prompt, expected_prefix, tags. keep entries <= 512 tokens.
lee: sample cronjob YAML: ```yaml apiVersion: batch/v1 kind: CronJob metadata: name: kv-canary-replay spec: schedule: "45 2 * * *" jobTemplate: spec: template: spec: containers: - name: replay image: ghcr.io/redwood/replayer args: ["--src","s3://incident-archives/kv-evict/sample.jsonl","--target","staging","--concurrency","30","--max-tokens","200"]```
infra-bot: Canary window scheduled draft created. IR approval required 48h before first run. React with :white_check_mark: to approve.
tomas: for rollbacks during the canary, we'll add a quick routing toggle and a scripted terraform apply rollback. will draft runbook.
claudia: also adding a small metric to console: kv_miss_streak and fallback_activation_count. will open console ticket and link to PR.
lee: I'll push the helm PR by 1771260000 (3 days out) and post the staging link.
nina: starting prompt bank curation now, will upload an initial 10-sample preview later today: https://storage.redwood.ai/promptbanks/kv-evict-preview.jsonl
tomas: fuzz harness repo PR by 1771300000 (7 days). adding unit tests for tokenization edgecases.
claudia: action recap: - nina: prompt bank + upload + evals CI (6bd) - lee: canary replay cron + helm PR (3bd) - tomas: fuzz harness + tokenizer tests (7bd) - claudia: CI gating + console metrics ticket
claudia: marking items as blockers if not started by EOD tomorrow. ping @here for visibility :eyes: \nlee: small ask: include a short list of priority endpoints to replay (router, kv-proxy, model-router).
claudia: added in the repo checklist. thanks team.
